column3: Close to the Hebrew; “and you will become” is rendered “so shall you be.”
Close to the Hebrew; “amen” is rendered “So be it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “warned” is rendered “exhorted.”
Close to the Hebrew; the past “I brought” is rendered as future “I will bring.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the shameful thing” (Baal) is rendered “that shameful thing.”
The Hebrew is difficult; NKJV renders “doing the plan with the many” as “Having done lewd deeds with many.”
Close to the Hebrew; “its branches are bad” is rendered “its branches are broken.”

Close to the Hebrew; “calamity” is rendered “catastrophe.”
